en.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir unit of the BJP paid rich tributes to Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya by organizing special events in Jammu and Srinagar.
en.headline: BJP marks Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya's birth anniversary in J&K
en.seo_title: BJP J&K marks Deendayal Upadhyaya birth anniversary
en.article_body:
The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)'s Jammu and Kashmir unit organized various events in Jammu and Srinagar to mark the birth anniversary of party ideologue Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya.

During an event held on Friday at the party headquarters in Trikuta Nagar, Jammu, BJP J&K President and Rajya Sabha MP Sat Sharma, along with other senior leaders, offered floral tributes to Upadhyaya.

Addressing the gathering, Sat Sharma recalled Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya's role in the Bharatiya Jana Sangh and specially mentioned his philosophy of Integral Humanism and Antyodaya. He said Upadhyaya's thoughts guide the party's vision for welfare and social development.

Meanwhile, a similar event was held at the party office in Jawahar Nagar, Srinagar, where BJP J&K General Secretary (Organization) Ashok Koul paid floral tributes to Upadhyaya. Waqf Board Chairperson Dr. Darakhshan Andrabi, BJP Vice President Dr. Shehnaz Ganai, Secretary Arif Raja, and other party leaders were present on the occasion.

In his address, Ashok Koul shed light on Upadhyaya's life and work, emphasizing his special focus on service, social unity, and equality. He also urged party workers to familiarize themselves with his political thoughts and principles. Similar tribute events and gatherings were held at various organizational levels across Jammu and Kashmir.

The objective of these events was to connect party workers with the thoughts of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya and to walk the path of social service in accordance with the principles he laid down.
en.seo_description: BJP J&K unit observed Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya's birth anniversary with events in Jammu and Srinagar, featuring tributes and speeches by senior leaders.

en.summary: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava has said that public health systems in the country are being strengthened through Ayushman Bharat and digital health initiatives.
en.headline: Ayushman Bharat and digital health initiatives strengthening healthcare: Health Secretary
en.seo_title: Ayushman Bharat & Digital Health Strengthen Healthcare
en.article_body:
Continuous efforts are underway to strengthen public health systems across the country, according to an official statement issued by the Union Ministry of Health. Ministry officials recently emphasized the expansion and improvement of healthcare services nationwide.

Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava shared important details regarding the country's public health systems. According to the ministry, initiatives like Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY), and e-Sanjeevani are bringing healthcare services closer to common citizens and communities. The objective of these schemes is to deliver accessible and quality healthcare facilities to remote areas of the country. The expansion of digital health initiatives and schemes is improving medical services for the general public.

As per the information provided by the Health Ministry, these schemes are playing a vital role in modernizing the nation's public health infrastructure. The expansion of digital health services is making it easier for citizens across the country to access healthcare benefits.
en.seo_description: Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava said initiatives like Ayushman Arogya Mandirs and e-Sanjeevani are bringing healthcare closer to communities.

en.summary: Soon after the launch of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, some users shared videos of colorful vertical lines on the display, though Apple is yet to officially respond.
en.headline: iPhone 18 Display Complaints: Vertical lines reported, videos go viral
en.seo_title: iPhone 18 Display Issue: Vertical lines reported on screen
en.article_body:
Early buyers are reporting display issues with the newly launched iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models. Several users have shared videos on social media claiming to see green, pink, and red vertical lines on the screens of the new smartphones.

Such technical glitches appearing right after the market debut of these premium smartphones have sparked discussions among consumers. According to available information, viral videos and posts on social media make various claims about these display problems. Some users are even linking these issues to Samsung. However, tech giant Apple has not released any official statement or response on the matter yet. Reports suggest the company has kept silent on these claims while awaiting clarity on the situation.

Such technical issues often pop up during the early stages of new hardware launches, grabbing the attention of the global tech market and consumers. Tech enthusiasts across India are also keeping a close eye on these reports, given the huge demand for Apple's new products in the country.

en.summary: Moses Simon is set to play his 100th match for Nigeria in the AFCON qualifying clash against Madagascar, with the NFF planning a special tribute.
en.headline: Moses Simon set for 100th Super Eagles appearance, NFF plans special honour
en.seo_title: Moses Simon to play 100th match, NFF to honour him
en.article_body:
Veteran Nigerian forward Moses Simon is set to play the 100th match of his international career in a crucial encounter against Madagascar. With this historic milestone, he will enter the exclusive 100-cap club, and the Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) has planned a special felicitation for him.

In his international career so far, Moses Simon has represented the team in 99 matches and scored 12 goals. His long journey began with his senior international debut on March 25, 2015. Out of these 99 matches, the team has secured 49 wins, 30 matches ended in draws, and they faced defeat in 20 outings. His consistency and dedication are drawing praise from across the sporting world.

This match is part of the qualifying campaign for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON). In past years, the team has secured spots in major tournaments through similar qualifying fixtures, and the NFF expects a strong performance in the upcoming matches as well.

en.summary: The Federation of All India Vyapar Mandal and CAIT have announced 'No UPI Day' on October 2 to protest against MDR, urging customers to make cash payments.
en.headline: Traders nationwide to observe 'No UPI Day' on Oct 2 against MDR charges
en.seo_title: No UPI Day on Oct 2: Traders to urge cash payments
en.article_body:
Trader bodies have decided to observe a nationwide 'No UPI Day' on October 2 as part of a special campaign. The move aims to strongly protest the provisions of the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR), over which the trader community is vocal.

This crucial announcement has been made by the Federation of All India Vyapar Mandal and the Confederation of All India Traders (CAIT). Traders associated with these bodies will urge customers to make cash payments instead of digital transactions on this day. Through this protest, concerns regarding financial charges and levies on digital transactions are being raised nationally.

This nationwide protest could directly impact everyday consumers and retail market transactions, as traders appeal to stay away from digital modes on this day. Traders across the country, including Chhattisgarh, are preparing to mount pressure for policy changes on their demands through this agitation.
en.seo_description: Traders nationwide will observe No UPI Day on Oct 2 to protest MDR charges, urging customers to make cash payments. Read the full report.

en.summary: According to health reports, millions of people self-medicate for issues like depression and anxiety every year, whereas antidepressants should only be consumed on a medical prescription.
en.headline: Antidepressants for depression and anxiety must be used only on medical prescription
en.seo_title: Take antidepressants only on medical prescription
en.article_body:
According to health experts and reports, millions of people across the country start taking medicines on their own (self-medication) without a doctor's advice to cope with mental health issues like depression, anxiety, and other mood disorders every year.

A recent health report revealed that amid rising cases of mental health disorders, people are consuming antidepressant medicines without medical consultation, which can be risky for health. According to health experts, these medicines should be used for the treatment of any type of mood disorder or mental health problem only and only on a doctor's prescription (medical prescription).

Experts say that consuming antidepressant drugs without medical supervision can lead to serious side effects, which can worsen the condition of patients. There is a strong emphasis on raising awareness across the country regarding this crucial aspect related to public health.
en.seo_description: Taking antidepressants without a doctor's advice for depression and anxiety is dangerous; know the key highlights from the health report.

en.summary: The Indian Air Force will host the second edition of Exercise Tarang Shakti at the Jodhpur air base from September 26 to October 11, featuring militaries from around 40 countries.
en.headline: IAF to host Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 at Jodhpur air base
en.seo_title: Tarang Shakti 2026: IAF to host Exercise in Jodhpur
en.article_body:
The Indian Air Force is organizing a large-scale military exercise in the country, with about 40 nations, including the US, France, and Germany, taking part. This multinational military event is scheduled at the Jodhpur air base and will run from September 26 to October 11.

The main objective of the exercise is to strengthen mutual coordination, combat synergy, and shared strategies between the Indian Air Force and participating global militaries. According to defense sources, special focus will be given during this period to lessons learned from Operation Sindoor.

The event will showcase fighter jets, transport aircraft, and special units, along with indigenous defense platforms like Tejas, Dhruv, and Prachand.

The training sessions include Dissimilar Air Combat Training, giving pilots a chance to practice against unfamiliar aircraft and new combat strategies. Additionally, the participation of the US F-35 stealth fighter will be a major highlight, offering key insights into fifth-generation capabilities, sensor fusion, and stealth technology.

Hosting this multinational exercise will give the Indian Air Force better control over training scenarios and allow more domestic personnel to experience international defense drills.
en.seo_description: IAF will host Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 in Jodhpur. 40 countries, including the US, France, and Germany, will participate.

en.summary: Preparations for Ganpati immersion are complete across the country as Ganesh Utsav comes to an end. Heavy security is deployed at Mumbai's Girgaon Chowpatty, while unique forms of Bappa are drawing crowds in various states.
en.headline: Ganesh Visarjan preparations complete, unique forms of Bappa seen across pandals
en.seo_title: Ganesh Visarjan: Full security in Mumbai, unique Bappa idols
en.article_body:
With the conclusion of Ganesh Utsav, all administrative and security arrangements for the immersion of Lord Ganesha idols have been completed across the country.

Extensive arrangements have been made keeping in mind the massive crowds and safety of devotees at Mumbai's prominent Girgaon Chowpatty. The administration and local bodies have deployed a large police force to ensure foolproof security so that the festival ends peacefully.

According to officials, over 21,000 police personnel have been deployed at Girgaon Chowpatty to ensure safety and smooth management. Drone cameras are being used for surveillance, and 25,000 Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation employees are also on high alert to manage the arrangements.

Meanwhile, unique forms of Ganpati Bappa installed in various pandals across Maharashtra and Rajasthan have become a special center of attraction for devotees nationwide. In Akola, an eco-friendly Ganpati idol made from 35,000 pearls has been installed, which is drawing huge praise for being environment-friendly. In Kota, Rajasthan, an idol of Bappa made from 21 kg of whole coriander has also caught people's attention. Additionally, a large number of devotees are visiting Ballarpur to catch a glimpse of Bappa adorned in the form of Lord Ranganatha Swamy.

Under cultural and social activities, Andheri's Swapna Parshwa Mitra Mandal has been awarded the best mandal prize for an event based on the theme of environmental conservation.

Along with traditional events, special emphasis has been laid by various mandals on the installation and worship of eco-friendly idols, spreading the message of environmental protection and raising awareness for the coming days.
en.seo_description: Ganesh Visarjan preparations complete. Heavy security at Mumbai's Girgaon Chowpatty and unique Bappa idols seen across various cities.

en.summary: On the occasion of Anant Chaturdashi, devotees and women kept a waterless fast and offered prayers with full devotion at the Durgabadi temple premises in Mahuatand.
en.headline: Mahuatand Durgabadi Temple: Women keep waterless fast on Anant Chaturdashi
en.seo_title: Women keep waterless fast on Anant Chaturdashi in Mahuatand
en.article_body:
A wave of religious faith and devotion was seen at the Durgabadi temple premises in the Mahuatand block area on the auspicious occasion of Anant Chaturdashi. Local mothers, sisters, and devotees kept a waterless fast with utmost dedication.

Gathering at the temple, devotees performed prayers with traditional rituals. According to reports, devotees started arriving at the Durgabadi temple premises since early morning for the festival.

Women observing the fast took the vow as per religious beliefs and participated in the special worship of Anant Chaturdashi. The entire temple premises remained filled with a devotional atmosphere throughout the rituals.

During the rituals, local citizens and devotees prayed with deep devotion. Families in the area showed special enthusiasm for the festival, with a large number of women gathering to listen to the vrat katha and complete the rituals.

Anant Chaturdashi fast holds special significance in Sanatan Dharma. On this day, devotees observe fasts wishing for the happiness, peace, and prosperity of their families. Local devotees turn up in large numbers during such religious occasions at the Durgabadi temple in Mahuatand every year.
en.seo_description: Devotees and women kept a waterless fast and performed rituals on Anant Chaturdashi at the Durgabadi temple in Mahuatand.
